text: {"label":"Qualitative and Mixed Research Methods","definition":"Work arguing for, guiding, and reflecting on the use of qualitative and mixed research methods to broaden behavior-analytic research and practice, including rigor, myths, lessons learned, and methodological diversity.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses specifically on qualitative and mixed research methodology, unlike broad reflections on applied behavior analysis's direction, theoretical dimensions of the science, or disseminating behavior science to the public."}
